q-1c8b: Review this test of the publication path. makeEditor supplies a fresh editor. stage receives a content object with two string fields; release publishes the staged content; published returns the released content. The test must fail if the editor erroneously rewrites either field before publishing, even if it rewrites the object it received. No browser or asynchronous behavior is in scope.
q-248c: Review this test of republishing. publish(older) sets the public snapshot, save(newer) changes only the draft, and publishSaved() must replace the public snapshot with the saved draft. readPublic() reads the visitor view; readPreview() reads the draft. The test must verify both fields in the visitor view before and after republishing. Assume operations do not mutate their inputs.
q-3df5: Review this test for a fixed-width summary element with overflow hidden. The full expected text must be present, the layout box must have positive height, and no vertical text may be clipped. For this fixture clientHeight is the inner height and scrollHeight is the full content height; font loading, horizontal overflow, and other clipping mechanisms are out of scope.
q-5a2e: Review this helper. createVisitor resolves to a new visitor with an async close(). Once acquired it must be closed exactly once, including when async verify rejects. If close succeeds, preserve the verification result or error. Failures in acquisition and close itself are out of scope.
